title: The North Gate
description: A gatehouse of black stone squats over the only road into Gallowmere. The portcullis is raised, rusted in place, and an old gibbet creaks from the arch above it. Beyond the walls the moor road runs north across the heather. Stone stairs climb to the wall walk, and the road runs south into town.

features.name: the gibbet
features.look: An iron cage hangs from a chain over the arch. Whoever was in it last has been gone a while. Mostly.

actions.touch: The cage swings at your touch and creaks loud enough to make the guard look up.
actions.take: It's chained to the arch, twenty feet up. Even if you could reach it, where would you put it?
actions.climb: You get a hand on the arch stones and think better of it. The guard is watching, and the cage is not quite empty enough.

features.name: the portcullis
features.look: Rust has welded the portcullis open. Nobody has closed this gate in years, and nobody seems keen to try.

actions.touch: Cold iron, rough with rust. It hasn't moved in years.
actions.push: You heave at the portcullis. It doesn't so much as rattle.
actions.climb: You climb a few bars, see nothing but fog in every direction, and climb back down.

title: Gate Road
description: Cart ruts have worn the cobbles into a muddy trough. Shuttered houses lean over the road as if listening. The watch barracks lie west, steps climb east toward the temple, and the market noise drifts up from the south.

features.name: the shuttered houses
features.look: Tall narrow houses with every shutter closed. One shutter twitches as you look, then goes still.

actions.push: You knock on a shutter. Inside, someone holds their breath until you leave.
actions.open: The shutters are barred from the inside. Of course they are.

title: Barracks Yard
description: A packed dirt yard where the town watch drills when it can be bothered. A notice board is papered with old bounties, most of them torn or rained into pulp. A stocks stands empty in one corner, its wood polished by unhappy necks. The watch house is north, Gate Road east.

features.name: the notice board
features.look: Old bounties, mostly rotted to pulp. One fresh notice reads: WANTED, the rat that ate the captain's boots. Reward negotiable.

actions.read: WANTED: the rat that ate the captain's boots. WANTED: whoever keeps writing on this board. NOTICE: the watch does not take bribes. Under that, in another hand: ask for Dace. And smaller still, a little drawing of a hook, and the words: above the fish.
actions.take: You tear the fresh notice down, feel the eyes of the empty barracks on your back, and pin it up again.

features.name: the stocks
features.look: A wooden stocks with holes for head and hands, polished smooth by the unlucky. Somebody has carved WORTH IT into the frame.

actions.sit: You settle into the stocks and rest your neck in the groove. It's oddly comfortable. That's the worrying part.
actions.touch: The wood is smooth as glass from all the necks.
actions.take: It's bolted to the yard. And heavy. And a stocks.

title: Temple Steps
description: Worn steps rise toward a squat temple of soot stained stone. Beggars have claimed the lower steps; the upper ones are kept clear by long habit and a short temper. Gate Road lies to the west.

features.name: the beggars
features.look: A row of beggars in grey rags, rattling cups at anyone who climbs past. They watch the temple doors more than they watch you.

actions.touch: The nearest beggar flinches away. "Coin, not hands," he says.
actions.search: Rummaging through beggars is a good way to get stabbed with a spoon. You leave it.
actions.take: Take a beggar? Nobody in this town comes that cheap.

title: The Temple of Ash
description: Cold air and the smell of old candles. Ash from a thousand offerings lies in drifts beneath a cracked altar, and a painted saint watches from the far wall with her eyes scratched out. Healing is sold here, they say, to those who can pay. The nave is east, the steps west.

features.name: the altar
features.look: A cracked stone altar heaped with grey ash. A brass bowl beside it is marked OFFERINGS, and it is chained down.

actions.touch: Ash coats your fingers. It's softer than it should be.
actions.search: You sift the ash. A tooth, two buttons and a copper so worn the face is gone. You leave them be. It feels like the right thing.
actions.take: The ash is the saint's, the bowl is chained, and the altar weighs as much as a horse.

features.name: the painted saint
features.look: A faded saint in a blue robe, her eyes scratched out long ago. Someone has painted a small smile back onto her mouth.

actions.touch: The paint is cold and a little tacky, as if someone touched up that smile recently.
actions.take: She's painted on the wall. She isn't going anywhere, and neither are her eyes.

title: Smithy Row
description: Heat rolls out of an open forge, and the hammer rings from dawn until well past sensible hours. Half finished blades hang from hooks along the wall. Hamo's shop floor is through a low door west. The market lies east.

features.name: the forge
features.look: A roaring forge, hot enough to make your eyes water from the doorway.

actions.touch: You reach toward the forge and the heat slaps your hand back. Good call.
actions.use: You give the bellows one pump. The fire roars. The blacksmith's look says do that again and lose the hand.

features.name: the half finished blades
features.look: Rough blades waiting for edges and hilts. None of them are for sale. Yet.

actions.take: You reach for a blade. The hammer stops. You put it back. The hammer starts again.
actions.touch: No edge on them yet. Give it a week.

title: Market West
description: Stalls of patched canvas crowd the west end of the market, selling rope, lamp oil and things that fell off other people's carts. A painted rat hangs over a low doorway to the south: The Drowned Rat. Old Tilly's curio shop is north, and Smithy Row lies west.

features.name: the stalls
features.look: Rope, lamp oil, bent nails, a single boot. Every stallholder swears their goods came by honestly.

actions.search: You poke through the stalls: rope, oil, a single boot. The stallholder watches you like you're the thief.
actions.take: The stallholder's hand lands on yours before you've lifted anything. "Coin first."

features.name: the painted rat sign
features.look: A wooden sign of a rat with its paws crossed over its chest, floating belly up. THE DROWNED RAT, it says, in case you missed the point.

actions.push: You swat the sign. It swings, and for a second the drowned rat seems to wink at you.
actions.take: You'd need a ladder, and a much better reason.

title: Market Square
description: The heart of Gallowmere, such as it is. A dry fountain holds a statue of some forgotten founder, his nose long since knocked off. Hawkers shout over each other, pickpockets work the crowd, the town crier's platform stands empty for now, and a noticeboard by the fountain is thick with paper. Stairs lead down to the market cellars, and roads lead in every direction.

features.name: the dry fountain
features.look: A dry fountain choked with rubbish. The founder's statue has lost its nose, and pigeons have claimed the rest.

actions.search: You dig through the rubbish in the bowl: a bent spoon, a letter too wet to read and one very surprised frog.
actions.climb: You clamber onto the founder's shoulders. The view is fog, roofs and more fog. A hawker applauds anyway.
actions.use: You try to drink from the fountain. It's dry, unless you count the rubbish.

features.name: the crier's platform
features.look: An empty wooden platform where the town crier shouts the news. A scrap of paper nailed to it says BACK SOON.

actions.climb: You climb onto the crier's platform. A few faces turn up, hoping for news. You have none. They turn away.
actions.read: BACK SOON, says the note. Someone has scratched a date under it. Three years ago.

features.name: the noticeboard
features.look: A slab of oak by the fountain, bristling with nails and paper. Wanted posters, gossip and notes from anyone with a pin.

actions.read: Too much to take in at a glance. Try: read notices.
actions.touch: Damp paper and a hundred rusty nails. Someone has carved INNOCENT into the wood, then crossed it out.

title: Market East
description: Grocers and fishmongers hold the east end of the market, and the smell holds everyone else. Baskets of grey turnips sit beside eels that are still deciding whether to die. Maud's Provisions is east, the counting house south, and Butcher's Alley runs north. Market Square lies west.

features.name: the eels
features.look: A barrel of river eels, still twitching. The fishmonger insists that means they are fresh.

actions.take: You grab an eel. The eel disagrees, strongly, and wins.
actions.touch: Slimy, cold and very much alive.
actions.smell: Fresh, the fishmonger says. Your nose says otherwise.

title: The Drowned Rat
description: A low ceilinged tavern, warm and loud and sticky underfoot. Smoke hangs under the beams, dice rattle in a corner, and a long scarred bar runs the length of the room. A stained curtain hangs on the west wall, and nobody looks at it for long. A ladder climbs to the rooms upstairs, a trapdoor drops to the cellar, the back door opens east on the yard, and the front door north leads to the market.

features.name: the stained curtain
features.look: A heavy curtain, stained with things best left unnamed. A draught stirs it now and then, as if there were a room behind it.

open.text: You pull the curtain aside. Behind it, a cramped storeroom of barrels and sacks. You could slip through to the west.
open.room: pulls the stained curtain aside and peers behind it.
open.event: pulls your stained curtain aside and peers into your back room

take.text: You grab a fistful of curtain and give it a good yank. It holds. Every head in the tavern turns.
take.room: yanks hard on the stained curtain.
take.event: grabs your stained curtain and tries to yank it down

actions.touch: Heavy, stiff with old spills and smoke. A cold draught leaks through from the west.

features.name: the dice game
features.look: A knot of drinkers hunched over a battered cup of dice. They stop talking when you get close.

use.text: You lean in to join the game. The players close ranks without looking up. Locals only, apparently.
use.room: tries to join the dice game and gets frozen out.

take.text: You scoop up the dice. Every player at the table goes very still. You put them back.
take.room: scoops up the dice from the game, then puts them back.
take.event: snatches the dice off your regulars' table, then puts them back

title: The Back Room
description: Behind the curtain, a cramped storeroom of barrels and sacks. One barrel is not like the others: it has a ledger tucked behind it, wrapped in oilcloth. The tavern lies east.

features.name: the oilcloth ledger
features.look: A ledger wrapped in oilcloth, full of neat columns of debts. Most of the pages are signed with a small drawing of a hook.

actions.read: Columns of debts, all owed to someone who signs with a small hook. The biggest line on the last page is in a heavy hand: The Drowned Rat, everything.
actions.take: You tuck the ledger under your arm, think about Morda, the docks and that little hook, and put it back exactly where it was.

features.name: the barrels
features.look: Ale barrels, flour sacks and a crate marked TURNIPS that is suspiciously heavy.

actions.search: Ale, flour and a crate marked TURNIPS full of something wrapped in sacking that is definitely not turnips. You decide you never saw it.
actions.open: You lever the lid off the turnip crate. Not turnips. You put the lid back very carefully.
actions.use: You put your mouth under an ale tap. Warm, flat, and still better than the river.

title: Wet Lane
description: A narrow lane that is never dry, sloping down toward the river. Water drips from every gutter and collects in black puddles. Somebody is always sleeping in a doorway here. The market is north, the docks south.

features.name: the black puddles
features.look: Puddles of black water that never dry. Something glints at the bottom of one, then it is gone.

actions.search: You reach into the black water. Your fingers close on something small and round, then it slips away. A coin. Probably.
actions.touch: Colder than it should be.

title: Docks Stair
description: Slick stone stairs drop to the riverside. The river is wide and brown and in no hurry. East, boats knock against the docks; west, a rusted grate breathes foul air out of the town wall.

features.name: the river
features.look: Wide, brown and slow. Things float by now and then, and it is best not to look too closely at them.

actions.touch: Cold, brown and slow. Something brushes your fingers and you pull back fast.
actions.use: You cup your hands, look at the water, and think better of drinking it. Wise.

title: River Docks
description: Rotting piers and fishing boats with names painted over other names. Crates are stacked high and watched closely by men who say they are not watching anything. The fish market is east, a beached hulk lies south on the mud, and the stair climbs west.

features.name: the stacked crates
features.look: Crates stamped with the marks of a dozen ports, several of them crossed out. A man nearby suddenly finds the sky very interesting.

actions.open: You get a fingernail under a lid. A man appears at your elbow. "Wrong crate, friend." You agree that it is.
actions.read: Port stamps from everywhere, half of them crossed out. One crate says FRAGILE in three languages and has been dropped in all of them.
actions.take: Too heavy to lift alone, and far too watched to try with help.

features.name: the harbourmaster's shed
features.look: A tarred wooden shed, locked tight. A sign on the door says CLOSED in large letters and BRIBES TUESDAYS in small ones.

actions.open: Locked. Bribes are Tuesdays, says the sign. Today is not Tuesday.
actions.push: You knock. Something heavy shifts inside, then goes very quiet.

title: The Sewer Grate
description: A great iron grate set into the base of the wall, where the town empties itself into the river. The bars are bent wide enough for a thin person, or a large rat. You could squeeze down through them. Something down there is scratching. The stair lies east.

features.name: the iron grate
features.look: Thick iron bars, bent apart by something strong or someone stubborn. A foul warm breath rises from the dark beyond.

actions.touch: Slimy bars, bent wide enough for someone thin. The air coming through is warm and foul.
actions.climb: You get a shoulder between the bars. It's a squeeze, but you'd fit. Go down if you've the stomach for it.

title: The Moor Road
description: The road north runs out of town across the open moor. The fog has drawn back at last, and someone has heaved the overturned cart into the ditch, where one wheel still turns in the wind. The ruts climb north up a rise of heather. The gate lies south.

features.name: the overturned cart
features.look: A farm cart heaved into the ditch, its load long since eaten by things with small teeth. The wheel still turns, slowly, though there's no wind you can feel.

actions.search: You go through the spilled load. Turnips, a broken harness and a muddy boot print far too big for a horse. You leave the rest to the fog.
actions.push: You heave at the cart. It rocks, settles back and the wheel keeps turning.

features.name: the fog
features.look: The fog has pulled back from the road to lie along the edges of the world, grey and patient. It does not come closer. Not yet.

actions.touch: Cold and wet. It clings to your fingers like it wants to come back into town with you.
actions.climb: You walk to the edge of the moor and into the fog a few steps, lose all sense of direction, and come out exactly where you went in, a little colder.

title: The Wall Walk
description: A narrow stone walk along the top of the town wall, slick with moss and gull droppings. From up here Gallowmere is a huddle of wet roofs and chimney smoke, the river a brown curve beyond. North, the moor road disappears into fog. Stairs lead down to the gate.

features.name: the view
features.look: Smoke from a hundred chimneys, the temple bell tower, the masts at the docks. From up here it almost looks like a place someone would choose to live.

actions.search: You pick out the market, the temple, the Rat. Down by the river a figure ducks into the net loft and doesn't come out.
actions.use: You take in the view. It doesn't take you in back.

features.name: the crenels
features.look: Gaps in the parapet, worn smooth by centuries of bored watchmen leaning on them.

actions.touch: Cold, damp stone. Someone has carved a tally of days into one merlon. They stopped at forty one.
actions.sit: You sit in a crenel with your legs over the drop. The wind tries to talk you into something stupid.

title: The Watch House
description: A low guardroom that smells of wet wool and cheap tallow. Spears lean in a rack, most of them rusty. A table is covered in dice, crusts and a duty roster nobody has updated in weeks. Stairs climb to the captain's office and a heavy door leads down to the lockup. The yard is south.

features.name: the spear rack
features.look: A dozen spears, half of them rusted to the rack. One has a sausage tied to the end.

actions.take: You lift a spear out of the rack. Nobody stops you, which is somehow worse. You put it back.
actions.touch: Rust comes off on your hand. These haven't seen a fight in years.

features.name: the duty roster
features.look: A slate with names chalked on it. Dace's name is on every gate shift. Someone has added: NOT AGAIN.

actions.read: NORTH GATE: Dace. NORTH GATE: Dace. NORTH GATE: Dace. Under it, smudged: ask Dace why he likes it so much.
actions.take: It's a slate nailed to the wall. You'd need the wall.

title: The Captain's Office
description: A cramped room with a desk too big for it and a window too small. The captain is never here. The chair is pushed back, the ink is dry, and a bottle sits half finished on a stack of unsigned warrants. The stairs lead down.

features.name: the warrants
features.look: Arrest warrants, months old, all unsigned. Several are for people who are clearly still drinking at the Rat.

actions.read: Theft of eels. Theft of more eels. Assault on a stallholder. Fencing stolen goods, name left blank, with a little hook drawn in the margin.
actions.take: You think about walking out with the town's justice under your arm. You put it back. Nobody would notice either way.

features.name: the bottle
features.look: Cheap brandy, half gone, with a ring of dust around the base. It has been half gone for a long time.

actions.use: You take a pull. It burns all the way down and makes your eyes water. You understand the captain a little better.
actions.smell: Turpentine, mostly. With notes of regret.

title: The Lockup
description: Three iron cages in a cellar that floods at high tide. Two are empty. The third holds a pile of straw that might be a prisoner or might just be straw. Water drips somewhere in the dark. Stairs lead up.

features.name: the cages
features.look: Iron bars thick as your thumb, rusted at the joints. The doors hang open. The town can't afford a jailer.

actions.open: The nearest cage door swings with a shriek that echoes up the stairs. Somewhere above, nobody comes to check.
actions.touch: Cold and rough. Someone has scratched a calendar into the wall behind one of them.

features.name: the straw
features.look: Damp, filthy straw. It moves, just slightly, when you aren't looking straight at it.

actions.search: You poke the straw. It snores. You stop poking the straw.
actions.kick: You nudge it with a boot. A hand comes out, takes nothing, and goes back in.

title: The Nave
description: Rows of benches face a pulpit where Father Osmund preaches to whoever is too drunk or too cold to leave. Candles gutter in iron stands and the walls are black with old smoke. A door north leads to the healer's ward, stairs drop to the ossuary, and a ladder climbs into the bell tower. The altar room is west.

features.name: the benches
features.look: Old wooden benches, worn smooth. Someone has carved their initials into every one, along with some opinions about the sermons.

actions.sit: You sit on a bench. It creaks. The silence of the place settles on your shoulders like a wet coat.
actions.read: Initials, hearts, a crude drawing of the priest, and in tiny careful letters: HE DOESN'T BELIEVE IT EITHER.

features.name: the candles
features.look: Tallow candles, cheap and smoky, in iron stands. A tin box beside them is marked ONE COPPER EACH.

actions.take: You reach for a candle. The tin box rattles meaningfully. Father Osmund sells them, if you want one.
actions.use: You light a candle from another. For a moment the nave is a little warmer. Then a draught takes it.

title: The Healer's Ward
description: Six cots, clean sheets, and a smell of vinegar and boiled linen. It is the only clean room in Gallowmere and the most expensive one. A shelf of bottles and bandages stands behind a locked grille. The nave is south.

features.name: the cots
features.look: Narrow beds with clean sheets. One has a name scratched into the frame and a date. Under it someone has written SURVIVED.

actions.sit: You sit on the edge of a cot. It's the softest thing you've touched since you came out of the fog. You don't trust it.
actions.search: Under one cot: a single tooth and a copper coin. You leave both. This feels like a place that keeps count.

features.name: the locked grille
features.look: Bottles of tinctures, rolls of bandage, jars with handwritten labels. Locked behind iron. Father Osmund has the only key.

actions.open: Locked. The keyhole is clean and well oiled. Someone opens this often.
actions.read: The labels say: Poppy. Willow. Vinegar. Mercy, 20 coin.

title: The Ossuary
description: A low vault under the temple, stacked floor to ceiling with bones. Skulls line the walls in neat rows, each with a name painted on the brow, though most have faded. It is very quiet down here. Stairs lead up.

features.name: the skulls
features.look: Rows of skulls, each painted with a name. Some are recent. One brow is still blank, freshly scrubbed, as if waiting.

actions.read: Agnes. Wat. Old Dodd. A Stranger, Found in the Fog. A Stranger, Found in the Fog. A Stranger, Found in the Fog.
actions.take: You lift a skull. Its painted name is your own. You blink, and it isn't. You put it back very carefully.

features.name: the bone stacks
features.look: Thigh bones stacked like firewood. They've been here a long time and they're in no hurry.

actions.search: You go through the stacks and find nothing but more bones and a feeling of being watched by all of them.
actions.touch: Dry and light. You wipe your hand on your coat and keep wiping it for a while.

title: The Bell Tower
description: A ladder climbs into a draughty wooden tower where a cracked bronze bell hangs from a blackened beam. Pigeons scatter. Through the louvres the whole town lies below, and past the wall, the endless fog. The ladder leads down.

features.name: the bell
features.look: A big bronze bell with a crack running from lip to crown. It hasn't rung true in years.

use.text: You haul on the rope. The bell gives a cracked, flat clang that rolls across every roof in town. Every dog in Gallowmere starts barking.
use.room: rings the cracked bell. The whole town hears it.

actions.push: You shove the bell. It swings a little and hums, low and sour, for a long time after.
actions.touch: Cold bronze. The crack is wide enough to slip a coin into. Several people have.

features.name: the louvres
features.look: Wooden slats open to the wind. Below: the market, the docks, the river. Above: rain, mostly.

actions.search: You look out over the town. A figure on the docks climbs to the net loft and pulls the ladder up after them.
actions.climb: You lean out through the louvres. The drop to the cobbles is long enough to think about on the way down. You lean back in.

title: Maud's Provisions
description: A narrow shop crammed floor to rafters with sacks, barrels, coils of rope and strings of onions. Everything is priced in chalk and the chalk is smudged in Maud's favour. A counter of scarred oak stands between you and the goods. Market East is west.

features.name: the price board
features.look: A slate of prices in Maud's square hand. Several numbers have been rubbed out and written again, higher.

actions.read: Bread 2. Turnips 2. Rope 6. Lamp 9. Oil 3. Candle 2. Sack 2. Below, underlined twice: NO CREDIT. NO HAGGLING. (The second rule is clearly negotiable.)
actions.take: It's nailed to the wall. Maud would nail you next to it.

features.name: the sacks
features.look: Flour, oats, dried peas, salt. Everything here has a smell and they're all fighting.

actions.search: You poke through the sacks. Maud's voice comes from behind the counter: "Buy it or leave it be."
actions.take: Maud's hand is on the counter, palm up, before you've even lifted it. Ask her for a list.

title: Butcher's Alley
description: A slick, narrow alley behind Market East where the butcher hangs his meat and the flies hang around it. The cobbles run red after rain and sometimes before it. A chopping block stands under an awning. A scrubbed stone doorway east leads into the Gatherers' Hall. Market East is south.

features.name: the chopping block
features.look: A thick stump scored with a thousand cuts. A cleaver is buried in it, handle up.

actions.take: You grip the cleaver and pull. It doesn't come out. The butcher, somewhere, laughs.
actions.touch: Sticky. You decide not to think about it.

features.name: the hanging meat
features.look: Sides of mutton and something that might have been a goat swing from iron hooks. The flies have opinions.

actions.smell: Blood, sawdust and old fat. Your stomach turns over and then, traitorously, rumbles.
actions.take: You reach for a joint. A dog under the awning growls in a voice much too deep for its size.

title: The Counting House
description: A cold stone room with one window, barred, and one counter, also barred. Behind the bars Ingelram the clerk sits among ledgers and scales, weighing coin with the care other men give their children. Coin deposited here is safe from the plague cart, they say. Market East is north.

features.name: the scales
features.look: Brass scales, polished bright. Ingelram weighs every coin twice and trusts neither result.

actions.touch: Ingelram's quill raps your knuckles through the bars before you get close.
actions.use: Ingelram weighs a coin, frowns, weighs it again and drops it in a box marked LIGHT.

features.name: the ledgers
features.look: Thick ledgers bound in black leather, every page ruled and every column added twice.

actions.read: Columns of names and figures. Yours is in there now, small and unimportant.
actions.take: The bars are in the way. So is Ingelram, who has stopped writing to watch you.

title: Tilly's Curios
description: A dark little pawnshop off Market West, every shelf heaped with the things people sold when they ran out of better ideas: wedding rings, false teeth, a stuffed heron, a single good boot. Old Tilly sits in the middle of it all like a spider. Market West is south.

features.name: the heaped shelves
features.look: Rings, buckles, spoons, a glass eye, a lute with two strings. Each has a paper tag and a story nobody wants told.

actions.search: You turn over the junk. A locket opens to show a tiny painted face that has been scratched out. You close it.
actions.take: Tilly coughs once. It's the cough of a woman who has been robbed before and remembers every face.

features.name: the stuffed heron
features.look: A heron, stuffed badly, one glass eye looking at you and the other at the door.

actions.touch: Dusty feathers and a smell of camphor. One wing falls off. You prop it back up and hope Tilly didn't see.
actions.take: "Not for sale," says Tilly. "That's Gerald."

title: Hamo's Shop Floor
description: Behind the forge, a low room of racks and hooks where finished work waits for buyers. Knives, hinges, horseshoes, nails by the bucket. A rack at the back holds blades under a tarp. It's hot even here, and everything smells of iron. Smithy Row is east.

features.name: the tarp
features.look: Under the tarp: swords, cudgels and axe heads, sharp and unbloodied. The tag that said NOT YET has been torn off.

actions.open: You lift the tarp. Steel glints. "Shop floor's west," says Hamo, without looking up. "Pay first."
actions.take: Your hand barely touches the tarp before the hammer next door goes quiet. You step back. It starts again.

features.name: the nail buckets
features.look: Buckets of nails sorted by size. Someone has sorted them very carefully and then kicked one over.

actions.search: You sift through the nails and come up with a splinter of iron in your thumb and nothing else.
actions.kick: You kick a bucket. Nails everywhere. From the forge, a long, slow sigh.

title: The Market Cellars
description: A warren of brick vaults under Market Square where the stallholders keep their stock and the rats keep the stallholders honest. Lanterns are few. Things get lost down here and some of them get found. Stairs lead up to the square.

features.name: the discarded crates
features.look: Broken crates and rotten sacking, the leftovers of a hundred market days. People throw away all kinds of things.

actions.kick: You kick a crate apart. Rats boil out of it in every direction and you regret everything.
actions.take: Rotten wood and wet sacking. Nothing here is worth carrying except what's buried in it. Try searching.

features.name: the dark corners
features.look: The vaults go back further than the lantern light. Something drips. Something else scuttles.

actions.listen: Water. Rats. And under them, far off, a slow knocking like someone patient behind a door.
actions.climb: You feel along the wall into the dark and find a bricked up arch. Fresh mortar. Interesting.

title: Rooms Above the Rat
description: A creaking landing over the tavern with four doors, three locked. Through the floorboards comes the noise of the bar, and through the walls comes the noise of guests who paid for the night. A ladder leads down.

features.name: the doors
features.look: Four doors with brass numbers. Three are locked. The fourth is ajar and smells of someone else's feet.

actions.open: The open door shows a bed, a pot and a window that doesn't close. Morda rents these by the night, if you ask her.
actions.push: You knock on a locked door. It goes very quiet inside. Then someone very carefully shoots the bolt.

features.name: the floorboards
features.look: Gaps wide enough to see the bar below. Also to hear it.

actions.search: Through the gap you watch Morda slip something under the bar when she thinks nobody's looking.
actions.listen: Below you, Morda: "...not until Tuesday, and tell Hook I said so."

title: The Dice Cellar
description: Under the Rat, a low beer cellar where the serious games happen. A plank table stands between the barrels with a candle stuck to it. The stakes here are higher and the players don't smile. A ladder leads up.

features.name: the plank table
features.look: Scarred, wax spattered, with a cup of dice and a pile of coin. The players watch your hands, not your face.

actions.use: You reach for the dice cup. A knife lands point first in the plank next to your fingers. "Coin on the table first," says a voice. You don't have the nerve. Yet.
actions.search: Under the table: a loaded die, weighted toward six. Somebody here is a cheat. Everybody here is a cheat.

features.name: the beer barrels
features.look: Barrels of Morda's ale, chalked with dates. Some of the dates are very old.

actions.use: You sneak a mug from a tap. It tastes better down here. That's probably the thrill.
actions.kick: The barrel booms. Upstairs, Morda bangs on the floor.

title: The Rat's Yard
description: A muddy yard behind the tavern, walled in, with a privy, a woodpile and a midden heap that steams in the cold. Empty casks are stacked against the wall. The back door to the tavern is west, and a lane runs south to a door under a lantern.

features.name: the midden heap
features.look: Kitchen scraps, broken crockery, ash and worse. It steams. Things are buried in it that people meant to stay buried.

search.text: Holding your breath, you dig through the midden.

actions.smell: It smells exactly like you'd think. Then a little worse.

features.name: the empty casks
features.look: Empty ale casks waiting for the cooper. One has a chalk mark: HOOK, TUESDAY.

actions.read: HOOK, TUESDAY. Then a tally of marks, and a sum that makes your eyes water.
actions.kick: Hollow boom. A cat shoots out of one and over the wall.

title: The Fish Market
description: Slimed stone slabs under a leaking roof where the morning catch is gutted, sold and argued over. Gulls scream from the rafters. The floor is a slurry of scales and guts, and the smell gets into your clothes and stays. The docks are west, the harbour office north, and a ladder climbs to the net loft.

features.name: the gutting slabs
features.look: Long stone slabs crusted with scales. Under them, a gutter full of offal and whatever the fishwives dropped.

search.text: You rake through the gutter under the slabs.

actions.smell: Fish. Old fish. The ghost of fish. It will be on you for a week.

features.name: the gulls
features.look: Fat, mean gulls in the rafters, waiting for anyone to drop anything.

actions.kick: You swing at a gull. It doesn't even move. Another one gets you from behind.
actions.touch: A gull lets you get close, then takes a piece of your sleeve.

title: The Harbourmaster's Office
description: A tarred wooden room over the water, full of charts, tide tables and confiscated goods nobody ever came back for. The harbourmaster is out, as always. A sign on the desk says BRIBES TUESDAYS. The fish market is south.

features.name: the confiscated goods
features.look: Crates, bales and barrels with seizure tags. The tags are old. The seals are broken. Someone has been helping themselves.

actions.search: Tags signed by the harbourmaster, all dated Tuesdays. Every crate is lighter than its tag says.
actions.take: You lift a bale. Under it, a second sign: THIS MEANS YOU. You put it back.

features.name: the tide tables
features.look: Columns of tide times, inked and reinked. Some boats are marked with a little hook.

actions.read: High water, low water, and beside certain dates, small hooks. Always at night.
actions.take: Too big to carry, too dull to steal.

title: The Net Loft
description: A long dim attic over the fish market, hung with drying nets and smelling of tar and salt. Floats and oars are stacked in the corners. At the far end, behind a hanging net, the plank wall looks newer than the rest. A ladder leads down.

features.name: the drying nets
features.look: Heavy fishing nets hung from the beams to dry. One hangs lower than the others, right against the west wall.

open.text: You pull the low net aside. Behind it the planks of the west wall don't quite meet, and there's a latch on this side. You could go west.
open.room: pulls a net aside and looks at the west wall for a long moment.

actions.search: Tangled in the nets: fish scales, a gull feather, and a little brass hook, the kind you'd wear as a sign.

features.name: the floats and oars
features.look: Cork floats, cracked oars and a stack of lobster pots. Nothing worth stealing, which is why nobody guards it.

search.text: You go through the junk in the corners.

actions.kick: A float rolls away across the boards and drops through a hole into the fish market. Someone below swears.

title: Hook's Back Room
description: A windowless room behind the net loft, warm, dry and lamplit, which in Gallowmere means money. Shelves hold things that were somebody else's yesterday. A ledger lies open on a table next to a scale, a knife and a plate of very good cheese. The way out is east.

features.name: the shelves of goods
features.look: Candlesticks, a church plate, three wedding rings, a good cloak, a lute with all its strings. All very clean. No questions asked or answered.

actions.take: Hook doesn't even look up. "Buy it, or keep your fingers."
actions.search: Price tags in tiny neat writing, and on every one, a little drawing of a hook.

features.name: Hook's ledger
features.look: An open ledger, the twin of the one in the Rat's back room. The same neat columns. The same little hooks.

actions.read: Names you know. The Drowned Rat, everything. The harbourmaster, Tuesdays. The captain of the watch, a lot. And a fresh line, ink still wet, with space left for a name.
actions.take: Hook's knife is suddenly on the ledger, between your hand and the page. "No."

title: The Hulk
description: An old ship beached on the mud south of the docks, her back broken and her ribs open to the sky. Children dare each other to go in. Scavengers don't need daring. The tide comes up to her keel twice a day. The docks are north.

features.name: the ship's ribs
features.look: Blackened timbers curving up out of the mud. Barnacles, weed, and caught in between, everything the river ever lost.

search.text: You climb into the wreck and sift the mud between her ribs.

actions.climb: You climb up the ribs to what's left of the deck. The whole wreck groans. You climb back down faster.

features.name: the figurehead
features.look: A carved woman at the bow, face worn smooth by the river, one hand raised as if to wave or warn.

actions.touch: Smooth, wet wood. Someone has tied a ribbon round her wrist. It's new.
actions.read: Faded paint on her chest: the ship's name. THE PATIENCE.

title: The Grate Tunnel
description: Past the bent bars the sewer runs into the dark, a brick tunnel just high enough to walk stooped. Foul water flows ankle deep down the middle. Scratching echoes from somewhere ahead. Light comes from the grate above and nowhere else. The overflow is west.

features.name: the foul water
features.look: Black water carrying the whole town's business down to the river. Things float in it. You don't look closely.

actions.search: You feel along the bottom. Something soft. Something hard. Something that moves. You stop.
actions.smell: Your eyes water. Your stomach tries to leave without you.

features.name: the scratch marks
features.look: Deep scratch marks on the bricks, in sets of four, at about knee height. Fresh.

actions.touch: The grooves are deep enough to fit your fingertips. Whatever made them has claws and patience.
actions.read: Not words. Not quite. But they go somewhere, and they all point west.

title: The Overflow
description: A round brick chamber where three tunnels meet and the water pools before it drains to the river. Bones lie on a ledge, small ones, picked clean. The scratching is louder here. North, a heavy iron door is set into the brick. The tunnel back is east.

features.name: the bone ledge
features.look: A dry ledge above the waterline, heaped with small bones and scraps of cloth. A nest, of sorts.

actions.search: Cat bones. Dog bones. A shoe with no foot in it. You decide you've seen enough nests.
actions.take: Something squeals from inside the pile. You don't take anything.

features.name: the drain
features.look: A grated drain swallows the pooled water with a long sucking sound.

actions.listen: Under the gurgle, a rhythm. Knock, knock, knock. Slow. Patient. North.
actions.push: You lean on the drain grating. It doesn't move. Something on the other side does.

title: Before the Iron Door
description: The tunnel ends at an iron door set deep in old stone, older than the sewers around it. It is chained, padlocked and painted with a warning in red: DO NOT. From the other side comes a slow knocking that stops when you get close. The door is north, if you can get through it. The overflow is south.

features.name: the iron door
features.look: Riveted iron, black with age, held shut with a chain as thick as your wrist and a padlock the size of your fist.

actions.open: Chained and padlocked. An iron key would open it, or a shoulder strong enough to force it. Go north to try.
actions.push: You push. The door doesn't move. On the other side, something pushes back.

knock.text: You knock twice. The knocking on the other side stops. Then, slowly, it knocks twice back.

actions.listen: Silence. Then, very close to the iron: breathing.

features.name: the red warning
features.look: DO NOT, in red paint, the letters run and dried. Under it, scratched small: we tried.

actions.read: DO NOT. And smaller, scratched: we tried. And smaller still, almost gone: it remembers.
actions.touch: The paint is old and flaking. It comes away red on your fingers like it was never quite dry.

north.locked: The iron door is chained and padlocked. A key would open it. So might someone strong enough to force it (level 5).
north.unlock: You fit the iron key to the padlock. It turns with a scream of rust, the chain drops, and the door swings in on the dark.
north.forced: You set your shoulder to the door and heave. The rotten chain gives with a crack, and the door grinds open on the dark.

title: The Old Cistern
description: Past the iron door the stone changes: older, cut finer, wet with a black water that fills a great round cistern to within a hand of its rim. A narrow walk runs around the edge. Things swim in it, and some of them are rats the size of dogs. Passages lead east and west. The iron door is south.

features.name: the black water
features.look: Still and black and deep. Every so often the surface bulges, as if something underneath rolled over.

actions.touch: Cold enough to ache. Something brushes your fingers and is gone.
actions.search: You feel along the rim and come up with nothing but slime and a long, pale hair.
actions.drink: You'd sooner drink from the river. The river is better than this.
actions.listen: Water dripping. Claws on stone. And, far off east, a sound like many small voices at once.

features.name: the old carvings
features.look: Faces cut into the stone above the waterline, worn almost smooth. They are all looking down into the water.

actions.touch: The faces are cold and slick. One of them has had its eyes chiselled out, recently.
actions.read: Not letters. A tally: hundreds of short cuts in groups of five, running round the whole chamber.

title: The Bone Shelf
description: A long dry shelf above the waterline where the cart men tip whatever Hook won't buy. Bones, boots, broken things, and things nobody wanted to look at twice, heaped higher than your head. Something in the heap moves when you don't. A low opening leads north. The cistern is west.

features.name: the heap
features.look: The town's leftovers. Mostly bones. Some of them still have boots on.

search.text: You pick through the heap, trying not to think about it.

actions.smell: You were wrong about the cistern. This is the worst smell in Gallowmere.
actions.listen: Shifting. Settling. Then a squeak, and the whole heap goes still.

title: The Smugglers' Cut
description: A dry passage cut through the rock at a slant, with iron rings in the wall for lanterns that are long gone. Someone used this once to move things the harbourmaster never saw. Wooden steps climb up into darkness that smells of tar and the river: the hulk. The cistern is east.

features.name: the iron rings
features.look: Rusted lantern rings, every ten paces. One still holds the stub of a candle.

actions.take: Rusted solid into the rock.
actions.touch: Rust comes off on your fingers like dried blood.

features.name: the wooden steps
features.look: Tarred planks nailed into the rock, climbing to a square of grey light: the belly of the hulk.

actions.climb: The steps creak but hold. Go up to reach the hulk.
actions.touch: Sticky with old tar. Somebody kept these in good repair, once.

title: The Nest
description: A low round chamber packed with straw, cloth and gnawed bone, warm as a stable and loud with squeaking. The walls are scratched floor to ceiling. Whatever lives here has lived here a long time, and it does not like visitors. The only way out is south.

features.name: the straw
features.look: Stolen bedding, sacks and shirts, packed down hard and stinking.

actions.search: You dig into the bedding and find a nest of pink blind young. You put the straw back.
actions.smell: Ammonia, rot and something sweet underneath. Your eyes stream.

features.name: the scratched walls
features.look: Every inch of the wall is scored with claw marks, layer over layer, years deep.

actions.read: In among the scratches, cut by a human hand: DO NOT. we tried. it remembers.
actions.touch: The grooves are warm.

title: Heather Rise
description: The road climbs a low rise of wet heather and the wind finds you at once. Behind you the walls of Gallowmere squat black on the moor; ahead the ruts run on north. Thin woods begin on either side, birches to the east and a heath edge to the west. The Moor Road is south.

features.name: the heather
features.look: Knee high, brown and purple, soaked through. It hides the ground well enough to turn an ankle.

actions.touch: Cold and wet. Your sleeve is soaked to the elbow.
actions.search: You part the heather and find a sheep's skull, a lost hobnail and a great many beetles.

features.name: the town walls
features.look: From out here Gallowmere looks smaller, and darker, and very much like it is watching you go.

actions.listen: Faintly, on the wind, the temple bell counting the hour. Then only wind.
actions.touch: Too far to touch. Close enough to feel.

title: The Gibbet Milestone
description: A squat milestone leans beside the road with GALLOWMERE 1 cut deep into its face, and beside it stands a gibbet, empty but for a few links of chain. The woods close in on both sides here: a clearing with a smudge of smoke to the west, a deer path to the east. The road runs north and south.

features.name: the milestone
features.look: GALLOWMERE 1, cut deep and filled with lichen. On the north face, fainter, someone has scratched VESNA 9 and a little drawing of a closed eye.

actions.read: South face: GALLOWMERE 1. North face, scratched by a later hand: VESNA 9, and a small closed eye.
actions.touch: The letters are worn smooth by hands. People touch it for luck, or the opposite.
actions.sit: You sit on the milestone. It is exactly as comfortable as a stone.

features.name: the gibbet
features.look: A tall post and crossbar with a short length of chain swinging from it. The ground below is bare, as if nothing will grow there.

actions.touch: The chain is cold and swings at your touch, chiming against the post.
actions.climb: You get halfway up the post before the creaking makes you think better of it.
actions.search: Under the gibbet the ground is bare and trodden. A single bootlace, rotted through.

title: Drovers' Ford
description: A stream crosses the road here, wide and shallow over flat stones, loud with its own business. Drovers watered their herds at this ford once; their stakes still stand in the mud. The stream runs away west toward the black shine of a lake, and a wet ditch runs east into the trees. The road goes on north and south.

features.name: the stream
features.look: Clear, quick and cold. Minnows flick between the stones, and now and then something bigger holds still in the deeper run.

actions.drink: You cup your hands and drink. Cold enough to hurt your teeth, and clean, which is more than the town water ever was.
actions.touch: So cold your fingers ache at once.
actions.listen: The ford talks to itself over the stones, endlessly, about nothing.

features.name: the drovers' stakes
features.look: Old wooden stakes driven into the bank, grey and split. A few still have rope burned into them.

actions.touch: Soft with rot. One wobbles like a bad tooth.
actions.search: Wedged between two stakes, a rotten halter and a drover's tally stick with notches on it.

title: The Toll Stump
description: A burnt out toll house stands beside the road, four black walls around nothing, and in front of it the stump of the old toll bar. Nobody collects here any more. Supposedly. A track leads east into a darker wood. The road runs north and south.

features.name: the toll stump
features.look: The stump of a toll bar, burnt black, with an iron box bolted to it. The box has a slot for coins and no lid.

actions.search: The toll box is empty. Inside, worn into the iron, the shape of thousands of coins dropped one at a time.
actions.touch: Cold iron, colder than the day.
actions.knock: You rap on the toll box. Hollow. You feel, for a moment, that someone is waiting for you to pay.

features.name: the burnt toll house
features.look: Four black walls with the sky for a roof. A hearth stone, a door frame, and a smell of old smoke that never quite went away.

actions.search: Charcoal, broken slates and a tin plate. A ledger once, by the curl of burnt paper. Nothing you can read.
actions.touch: The charred wood comes away black on your fingers.
actions.listen: Wind in the empty windows. It sounds a little like someone counting.

title: Brigand's Bend
description: The road bends sharply between two high banks thick with holly, so you cannot see ten yards ahead or behind. It is a good place to be ambushed and everyone knows it. Through a gap in the east bank, a path climbs up into the trees. The road runs north and south.

features.name: the high banks
features.look: Steep earth banks crowned with holly. The kind of place where a man can crouch for an hour and not be seen.

actions.climb: You scramble up the bank and find a flattened patch in the holly, still warm, and a gnawed apple core. You scramble back down.
actions.search: Boot prints in the soft earth at the top of the bank. Several. Recent.
actions.listen: Nothing. Which is somehow worse than something.

features.name: the warning
features.look: Someone has cut a cross and three short lines into a holly trunk at head height. A traveller's warning, or a brigand's tally.

actions.read: A cross and three lines. Travellers' code for robbed here, three times, or brigands' code for three this week.
actions.touch: The cuts are fresh enough to still be pale.

title: The Burnt Waystation
description: A coaching inn once, burnt to its stone shell. Four walls stand and one corner of the roof, and under it a great hearth that still draws, black with other people's fires. Travellers stop here to cook and dry out. The road runs north and south.

features.name: the hearth
features.look: A wide stone hearth with a fire somebody keeps going, or a fire that keeps itself going. A pot hook hangs over it.

actions.touch: Warm. Your hands come back to life for the first time since the gate.
actions.sit: You sit by the hearth and let the heat soak in. The road feels further off.
actions.use: You hang your hands over the fire. Food can be cooked here: make campfire stew.

features.name: the old sign
features.look: A blackened sign hanging by one chain: a painted coach and four, and a name burnt away to THE ... AND ...

actions.read: THE ... AND ... The rest is charcoal. Underneath, scratched fresh: DON'T SLEEP HERE.
actions.touch: It swings and squeaks and drops flakes of soot on you.

title: Mile Oak
description: An oak older than the town stands at a fork in the road, so broad that six people could not join hands around it. Ribbons and scraps of cloth are tied to its lower branches. East, a path of worn stone steps climbs away toward a glimpse of red between the trees. The road runs north and south.

features.name: the great oak
features.look: Vast, grey and furrowed, with roots like the backs of buried animals. Somebody has driven nails into the trunk to hang things on.

actions.touch: The bark is warm, as oaks go. You feel foolish and then, oddly, better.
actions.climb: You get onto the first great limb and see the road both ways, and a red roof among the trees to the east.
actions.listen: Leaves, and somewhere high up a woodpecker hard at work.

features.name: the ribbons
features.look: Strips of cloth tied to the low branches, faded to the same grey, a few still red or blue. Prayers, or promises, or warnings.

actions.touch: Damp and stiff. One has a name stitched into it, too faded to read.
actions.take: You reach for a ribbon and stop. Somebody tied that there meaning it.

features.name: the stone steps
features.look: Worn stone steps climbing east into the trees, swept clean. Someone looks after them.

actions.touch: Swept, and smooth with use.
actions.search: Clean steps leading east, toward the red gates of a shrine.

title: The Long Climb
description: The road steepens and turns to stone underfoot, climbing toward a dark line of timber walls. West, the land rises in grey scree to the crags. The wind up here smells of snow and woodsmoke from somewhere ahead. Mile Oak is south, and the road goes on north to a gate.

features.name: the scree
features.look: Loose grey stone runs up from the road to the cliffs. A goat path zigzags across it.

actions.climb: You start up the scree and slide back down in a small avalanche of your own making.
actions.search: Among the stones, a blue feather and a bit of goat wool caught on a thorn.

features.name: the timber walls
features.look: Ahead, the road ends at a palisade of sharpened timbers taller than three men, black against the sky. Smoke rises behind it.

actions.listen: Very faintly, from behind the walls, a dog, a hammer, and someone singing.
actions.search: A palisade, a gate, and smoke from chimneys you cannot see.

title: The Shut Gate
description: The road ends at high timber gates bound with black iron, set in a palisade that runs away into the trees on both sides. The gates are barred from the inside. Beyond them you can hear voices, a forge, a cart, the ordinary noise of a town that is not letting you in. A painted board hangs above the gate. The road runs back south.

features.name: the gates
features.look: Oak timbers as thick as a man, bound with iron, scarred by old axes. A small shuttered hatch is set in one of them at head height.

knock.text: You hammer on the gate. The sound goes away into the wood, and after a moment the hatch scrapes.
knock.room: hammers on the gate of Vesna.
knock.event: knocks on the gate of Vesna. Answer through the closed hatch

actions.push: You put your shoulder to the gate. It does not so much as creak. Barred, and barred well.
actions.listen: Voices, close behind the timbers. They stop when you press your ear to the wood, and start again when you step back.
actions.touch: Cold, wet oak, and nails as big as your thumb.

features.name: the painted board
features.look: A board above the gate, freshly painted: VESNA, in tall letters, and under it a line in smaller ones.

actions.read: VESNA. Underneath: THE GATE OPENS WHEN IT OPENS.
actions.touch: Too high to reach.

title: The Heath Edge
description: Where the moor gives up and the wood begins: thin rowans, gorse and long tussocks, with sheep tracks wandering through. The road is a stone's throw east. The ground drops west into a bramble hollow, and a smudge of smoke rises among the trees to the north.

features.name: the gorse
features.look: Spiny yellow gorse in flower, out of season, smelling faintly of coconut out here where nobody has ever seen one.

actions.smell: Honey and coconut, absurdly sweet. Your nose doesn't believe it.
actions.touch: It bites. Every bit of it bites.
actions.search: Under the gorse, a wren's nest, empty, and a dry stick or two.

features.name: the sticks
features.look: Dead branches lie everywhere under the rowans, dry enough to burn.

actions.take: You gather a straight dry stick.
actions.search: Plenty of dry sticks here. Take one.

title: The Charcoal Burner's Clearing
description: A round clearing ringed with stacked cordwood, and in its middle a great earth mound smoking from a dozen small vents: a charcoal clamp, burning slow. A turf hut leans against an oak. Everything, including the air, is grey with soot. The road is east, a path drops south to the heath and a stream chuckles somewhere north.

features.name: the charcoal clamp
features.look: A dome of turf and earth over a stack of slow burning wood, breathing smoke. It will burn for days, and must never be let flare.

actions.touch: Warm right through the turf, like the flank of a sleeping animal.
actions.use: You warm your hands by the clamp. You could cook here too: make campfire stew.

features.name: the cordwood
features.look: Neat stacks of split wood, waiting their turn in the clamp. Loose sticks and offcuts lie all around.

actions.take: You help yourself to an offcut stick. The charcoal burner sees, and doesn't mind.
actions.search: Offcuts and dry sticks, enough for anyone.

title: Bramble Hollow
description: A damp dip full of brambles and black leaf mould where the light comes down green. The soil here is soft and dark and full of worms; birds work it constantly. The heath edge is east, and a run of rabbit tracks leads north.

features.name: the leaf mould
features.look: Rich black earth under rotting leaves. Turn it with your hands and it heaves with worms.

actions.search: Worms, beetles and a lost brass button. You could dig here for bait.
actions.smell: Wet earth and rot. Good fishing smell, a ditch man would say.

features.name: the brambles
features.look: Brambles everywhere, hung with the last shrivelled blackberries of the year.

actions.eat: You pick a few late blackberries. Sour and seedy, and better than nothing.
actions.touch: Thorns. Of course, thorns.

title: The Rabbit Runs
description: Short turf between hawthorns, criss crossed with narrow rabbit runs worn down to the earth. Droppings everywhere, and the white flash of a tail now and then. A good place to set a snare. The clearing is east, the hollow south, and the lake shore opens out to the north.

features.name: the rabbit runs
features.look: Narrow paths through the grass, worn by generations of rabbits all going the same way to the same places.

actions.search: Burrow mouths under every hawthorn, and runs between them. Set a snare on one: set snare.
actions.touch: The earth is beaten hard along the runs.

features.name: the hawthorns
features.look: Low, wind bent hawthorns with red berries and wicked thorns.

actions.touch: A thorn finds your thumb at once.
actions.search: Under the hawthorns, dry sticks and a tuft of grey fur.

title: The Birch Thicket
description: Silver birches crowd together here, white trunks marked with black eyes where branches fell. Their leaves shiver at nothing. The road is just west, a deer path runs north, and the ground slopes east into brown bracken.

features.name: the birches
features.look: White bark peeling in papery curls, and black knots like eyes that all seem to face the road.

actions.touch: Papery bark. It peels off in your hand like old skin.
actions.take: You peel off a curl of birch bark. Good tinder, if you had a fire to start.
actions.listen: The leaves never quite stop moving, even when the wind does.

features.name: the fallen branches
features.look: Birch branches brought down by the wind, light and dry.

actions.take: You pick out a good straight stick.
actions.search: Dry sticks, plenty of them.

title: The Deer Path
description: A narrow trodden path winds between hazels and old oaks, marked with slots in the mud where deer have passed. The road is close by to the west. The path runs south toward the birches and north toward wetter ground.

features.name: the slots
features.look: Neat split hoof prints, deep and fresh, all heading the same way.

actions.search: Deer, two of them, an hour ago. And among them, one big print with claws that is not a deer.
actions.touch: The edges are still sharp. Fresh.

features.name: the hazels
features.look: Hazel coppice, tall straight rods, and nuts in the leaf litter that the squirrels missed.

actions.eat: You crack a hazelnut with your teeth. Sweet. Then another.
actions.take: You cut a straight hazel rod. It would make a good stick.

title: The Wet Ditch
description: The Drovers' stream spills into a long wet ditch here and spreads out into a black, stinking bog under alders. Frogs plop into the water as you come. The ford is west, and north the trees grow darker and closer together. The deer path is south.

features.name: the ditch
features.look: Black water and blacker mud, crawling with life. Worms by the hundred in the soft banks.

actions.search: You turn over the bank mud. Worms, a leech, and a horseshoe rusted to lace. Good place to dig for bait.
actions.smell: Rot and marsh gas. Your eyes water.
actions.drink: You think about it, look at the leech, and don't.

features.name: the alders
features.look: Alders with their roots in the water and their bark grey green with moss.

actions.touch: Slippery with moss.
actions.climb: You climb a crooked alder a little way and see the dark of the Blackwood beginning just north.

title: The Bracken Slope
description: Dead bracken, waist high and rust red, covers a long slope falling away to the south east. Paths through it are made by animals. In the distance below, grey stones stand in a ring. The birches are west.

features.name: the bracken
features.look: Rusty dead fronds taller than your waist, crackling as you push through. Ticks, probably.

actions.search: Pushing through the bracken you find a fox's run and a scatter of feathers.
actions.touch: Dry and brittle; it breaks under your hands.

features.name: the distant stones
features.look: A ring of standing stones on a low rise to the south east, grey as the sky. A track leads down to them.

actions.listen: The wind changes note as it crosses the slope toward them.
actions.search: Grey stones in a ring, and a green mound beside them.

title: The Stones Track
description: A sunken track runs between grassy banks toward a ring of standing stones. The fog is close here, a grey wall only a field away to the south, and it does not move with the wind. The bracken slope is north, and the stones stand east.

features.name: the fog wall
features.look: A wall of fog, close and still, as if it were waiting at a border it had agreed not to cross.

actions.touch: You reach in. Your hand comes back wet, cold to the bone, and smelling of somewhere else.
actions.listen: Nothing at all comes out of the fog. Not wind, not birds.

features.name: the sunken track
features.look: A track worn deep by feet and carts over a very long time, deeper than the road to town.

actions.search: Old ruts, older than wheels should be. A flint scraper, chipped by hand, lies in the bank.
actions.touch: The banks are smooth, worn by passing shoulders.

title: The Old Stones
description: Nine grey stones stand in a ring on a low rise, leaning a little inward like people listening. In the middle the grass is short and very green. Beside the ring a long mound rises, turf over stone, and at its end a low dark doorway goes down into the earth. The track is west.

features.name: the standing stones
features.look: Nine stones, each taller than a man, crusted with lichen in rings and whorls. One has a hollow worn in it at hand height.

actions.touch: Cold, then not. Under your palm the stone seems to hum, very faintly, and stop.
actions.listen: Put your ear to a stone and you hear, or think you hear, the sea.
actions.search: In the hollow of one stone, offerings: a bead, a tooth, a copper gone green.

features.name: the barrow mound
features.look: A long mound of turf over piled stone, older than anything in Gallowmere. The doorway at its end is low and black and smells of earth.

actions.listen: From the doorway, the slow drip of water. And something else, like breath.
actions.touch: The lintel stone is carved with spirals, worn almost away.
actions.search: A low doorway down into the barrow. Utterly dark inside. You would want a light.

title: The Barrow
description: A long low passage of fitted stone running back into the mound, with side chambers like the pews of a church. Bones lie in them, very old, laid with care. At the far end, on a stone shelf, something gleams. The way out is up.

features.name: the side chambers
features.look: Small stone cells either side of the passage. In each, bones laid with their knees drawn up, and little pots beside them.

actions.search: Pots of dust, a bone comb, flint arrowheads. You put it all back exactly as it was.
actions.touch: The bones are light as paper. You stop touching them.

features.name: the stone shelf
features.look: A shelf at the end of the barrow. On it lies a twisted torc of dull gold, beside a skull that has been watching the door for three thousand years.

actions.touch: The torc is cold. The skull is colder.
actions.search: A gold torc, heavy and plain, laid in front of a skull. The rest of the shelf is dust.

title: The Stream Bank
description: The Drovers' stream runs west here between banks of yellow flag and kingcups, slowing as it nears the lake. Water voles plop in and out. The ford is east, the charcoal burner's clearing south, and the lake shore opens to the west.

features.name: the stream
features.look: Slow and brown and deep enough to swim, curling under the banks.

actions.drink: You drink. Cold and faintly peaty.
actions.touch: Cold. A vole surfaces, looks at you, and vanishes.

features.name: the yellow flags
features.look: Wild yellow iris along the bank, and gold kingcups at its foot.

actions.smell: Green and wet and faintly sweet.
actions.take: You pick a flag. It droops at once, as if it knew.

title: The Mere Shore
description: A black lake lies under the sky, still as poured tar, so dark you cannot see a hand's depth into it. A shingle beach curves away to a jetty in the west. Reeds stand thick to the north. The stream bank is east and the rabbit runs south.

features.name: the mere
features.look: Black water, still and deep. Far out, a ring spreads where something rose and sank again. There is an island out there, low and wooded, half lost in haze.

actions.drink: You drink from your cupped hands. It tastes of iron and old leaves.
actions.touch: Colder than the stream. Much colder. Your hand looks white under the surface.
actions.listen: Water lapping at the shingle, and very far out, something heavy turning over.

features.name: the shingle
features.look: Flat grey pebbles, worn smooth. Some are almost perfectly round.

actions.search: Pebbles, a broken net float, and the bones of a large fish, as long as your arm, its teeth like needles.
actions.take: You pick up a flat pebble and skim it. Four bounces. Something takes it on the fifth.

title: The Jetty
description: A long wooden jetty runs out over the black water on posts green with weed. A flat bottomed boat is tied at the end, and an old man sits beside it on an upturned crate. Out across the water a low wooded island floats in the haze. The shore is east, and a ruined boathouse squats to the west.

features.name: the boat
features.look: A flat bottomed boat, tarred black, with a pole and one oar. It rides low and steady.

actions.touch: Tarred wood, warm in the sun. The old man watches your hand.
actions.use: The ferryman rows people across, for a coin. Try: ferry.

features.name: the jetty boards
features.look: Grey planks with gaps between them through which the black water looks up at you.

actions.search: Between two planks, a hook and a coil of line someone dropped long ago.
actions.kick: You kick a plank. The ferryman looks at you as if you'd kicked his dog.

title: The Drowned Boathouse
description: A boathouse built half over the water, its far end sunk so that the floor slopes down and simply goes under. Old boats lie in the black water inside like drowned cattle. Nets hang from the rafters, rotted to lace. The jetty is east.

features.name: the sunken boats
features.look: Hulls under the water, ribs showing, weed waving from them. One still has its name painted on the stern.

actions.read: On one stern, just under the surface: GRANDMOTHER'S GRUDGE. Someone had a sense of humour, or a reason.
actions.touch: The water inside is very still, and very cold.

features.name: the rotten nets
features.look: Nets hanging from the rafters, grey and full of holes, still holding a few dried fish skeletons.

actions.search: Among the nets, a broken rod, floats and a hook as big as your hand, bent straight by something.
actions.take: The net comes apart in your hands into dust and string.

title: The Reed Beds
description: Reeds taller than your head close in on a squelching path of planks laid over the mud. Herons stand in the shallows like grey old men. The water here is open in places, dark pools among the stems. The shore is south, deep water opens west, and a stream comes tumbling down from the north.

features.name: the reeds
features.look: Brown reeds whispering against each other, with feathery heads. The planks between them are slippery.

actions.listen: Rustling everywhere, and now and then a bittern booming like someone blowing over a jar.
actions.take: You cut a reed. It's hollow and makes a thin, sad whistle.

features.name: the planks
features.look: Old planks laid end to end across the mud, half sunk.

actions.touch: Slimy and soft.
actions.search: Under a plank, eel holes in the mud, and an old bait tin with a picture of a pike on it.

title: The Black Water's Edge
description: A spit of land runs out into the mere and ends at a drop where the lake bed simply falls away. The water here is blacker than anywhere else, and it moves when nothing moves it. The fog stands on the far side of the lake like a cliff. The reeds are east.

features.name: the deep water
features.look: Black water dropping straight down. Things move in it, big things, slow, a long way down.

actions.touch: You dip your fingers. Something nudges them from below. You take them out.
actions.listen: A deep, slow sound, as if the lake were breathing.
actions.drink: You do not drink from here. Something about it says not to.

features.name: the fog cliff
features.look: The fog lies along the far shore like a wall, white and still.

actions.touch: Too far across the water to touch.
actions.search: The fog stands along the far shore. Nobody has come out of it in living memory.

title: The Island
description: A small wooded island in the middle of the mere, all yew and holly, with a ruined hermit's cell of piled stone at its heart. The water laps at a little shingle landing. Out here the lake is very quiet, and the shore you came from looks a long way off.

features.name: the hermit's cell
features.look: A beehive of piled stone with a low door, roof fallen in. Inside, a stone bench and a niche in the wall.

actions.search: In the niche, a wax stub and a smooth stone with a hole through it. Someone lived very simply here, a long time.
actions.touch: The stones are warm on the sunny side and cold on the other, as if two seasons lived here.

features.name: the old yew
features.look: An enormous yew, split down the middle and still alive, its roots heaving up the ground like a sleeper turning.

actions.touch: The bark is red and flaking. Under your hand the roots feel almost soft, as if the ground beneath them had been turned.
actions.search: Between the roots the ground is soft and sunk a little, as if something was buried and the earth settled.
actions.listen: Bees, deep inside the split trunk.

title: The Stream Climb
description: The stream comes tumbling down a rocky staircase between mossy boulders, loud and white. A path climbs beside it, wet and green. You can hear the roar of a waterfall above. The reed beds are south.

features.name: the boulders
features.look: Great round boulders furred with moss and ferns, wet with spray.

actions.climb: You scramble up a boulder and get a face full of spray and a view of the falls ahead.
actions.touch: Moss, soft as a pelt and soaking wet.

features.name: the stream
features.look: White water dropping over ledges in a hurry to get to the lake.

actions.drink: You drink. Cold, fast and sweet.
actions.listen: Too loud to hear yourself think, which is not unpleasant.

title: The Plunge Pool
description: A waterfall drops forty feet off a lip of black rock into a deep round pool, throwing up a mist that hangs rainbows in the air. The pool is clear and green, and trout hang in it like knives. A wet ledge runs up behind the falls. The path back is south.

features.name: the waterfall
features.look: A white curtain of water falling forever, so loud you feel it in your chest. Behind it, darkness.

actions.listen: A roar like the whole world breathing out.
actions.touch: The spray soaks you in a moment.
actions.search: The falls pour off the lip in a heavy curtain. Behind the water, where the rock should be, it looks darker than rock.

features.name: the pool
features.look: Green, clear water, deep, with trout holding steady against the current.

actions.touch: Your hand goes numb almost at once.

title: The Wet Ledge
description: A slick ledge of black rock runs along the cliff beside the falls, so close to the water that the spray hits you like rain. The rock is green with slime. Far below, the pool churns. The ledge climbs on up to the head of the falls, and back down to the pool.

features.name: the curtain of water
features.look: The falls thunder past an arm's length away. Where the ledge meets the water there is a gap, a darker dark behind the curtain.

actions.touch: The weight of it nearly takes your arm off. You pull back fast.
actions.search: The ledge runs on behind the falling water, into a gap in the rock. You could go west, if the rock is not too slick today.

features.name: the slime
features.look: Green black slime on wet rock. Every step is a guess.

actions.touch: Slick as soap.
actions.search: Scratches in the slime, as if someone else came this way and kept going west.

title: Behind the Falls
description: A cave behind the waterfall, the falling water a moving grey wall at its mouth. The air is wet and loud and full of a strange green light. The walls are covered in carvings. Somebody lived here once, or hid. The ledge is east.

features.name: the carvings
features.look: Carvings cover the walls: boats, fish, a fox with many tails, a gate with an eye over it, and long lines of tally marks.

actions.read: Boats, fish, a fox with nine tails leading a little figure along a path. A gate with a closed eye above it. Tally marks, hundreds. Someone counted something here for a very long time.
actions.touch: The cuts are deep and old, smoothed by damp.

features.name: the old bedding
features.look: A pallet of rotted straw against the back wall, and beside it a skeleton in the rags of a pilgrim's cloak, curled as if asleep.

actions.search: The pilgrim's cloak still has something in its pocket.
actions.touch: The straw turns to mush at your touch.

title: The Falls Head
description: The top of the falls: the stream slides glassy over a lip of rock and drops out of sight with a roar. Upstream it winds away into the hills. The view goes all the way to the lake, black and flat, with its island. A ledge goes down beside the falls, and the scree slope runs east toward the road.

features.name: the lip
features.look: Smooth rock where the water goes over. One step too far and you'd go with it.

actions.touch: You lie flat and reach out to the edge. The water tugs at your fingers like a dog at a rope.
actions.search: Straight down, forty feet of white water and the green pool. Your stomach goes first.

features.name: the view
features.look: The whole mere spread out below, black as a mirror, with its wooded island in the middle and the fog beyond.

actions.listen: The roar of the falls, and under it, from the lake, a faint bell? Gone.
actions.search: Black water, a wooded island, a jetty with a tiny boat, and beyond everything the fog.

title: The Scree
description: A long slope of loose grey stone under cliffs, rattling down at every step. Goat droppings everywhere. A goat path zigzags up toward the cliffs to the north. The Long Climb is east, and the falls head lies west.

features.name: the loose stone
features.look: Grey shards from the size of a coin to the size of a cart, all of it ready to move.

actions.kick: You kick a stone. It takes forty others with it, all the way down.
actions.search: Among the scree, a fossil shell, curled tight. The sea was here once.

features.name: the cliffs
features.look: Grey cliffs stained black with seeping water, ledges white with bird lime. Something big nests up there.

actions.climb: Not without the goat path. The cliff laughs at you.
actions.listen: An eagle's cry, high and thin, and stones trickling.

title: The Goat Path
description: A path no wider than your boot traces a zigzag across the face of the crags, with a long drop on one side and rock on the other. Goats use it as if it were a high road. The scree is south below you, and the path climbs up to a ledge.

features.name: the drop
features.look: Air, then scree, a long way down.

actions.kick: You kick a pebble off the edge and count. You stop counting.
actions.search: It's a long way down. The scree looks soft from here. It is not.

features.name: the goat path
features.look: A narrow shelf worn into the rock by goats, littered with their droppings.

actions.touch: Polished smooth by hooves.
actions.search: Tufts of goat wool on every thorn, and a bell on a broken strap.

title: The High Ledge
description: A broad ledge high on the crags, sheltered from the wind by an overhang. Bones are scattered about, gnawed. To the west a cave mouth gapes black in the cliff. A chimney of rock climbs on up to the summit. The goat path is down.

features.name: the gnawed bones
features.look: Goat bones, cracked for the marrow by jaws stronger than a wolf's.

actions.search: Goat bones, cracked open. Big teeth did this. Claw marks on the rock, at the height of your head.
actions.touch: Fresh enough to be greasy.

features.name: the rock chimney
features.look: A crack in the rock with footholds worn into it, climbing to the very top of the crags.

actions.climb: Up is that way. You could go up.
actions.search: Footholds, worn into the rock by hands and hooves.

title: The Eagle's Lookout
description: The summit of the crags: a bare dome of rock with the whole country laid out below like a map. The road runs south to the black walls of Gallowmere and north to the timber walls of Vesna. The forest spreads all around, and beyond everything, on every side, the fog. An eagle's nest of sticks the size of a cart sits on a ledge below. The way down is a chimney in the rock.

features.name: the view
features.look: Everything. The road, the two towns, the black mere and its island, the falls, the dark Blackwood, the red roof of the shrine. And the fog, all round, like the edge of the world.

actions.listen: Wind, and the eagle, and very far off, the bell of the temple tolling the hour.
actions.search: North: Vesna, smoke rising behind its palisade. South: Gallowmere, the bell tower. East: the Blackwood, and deep in it a thin line of smoke where no one should be. West: the mere, the falls. Everywhere else: fog.

features.name: the eagle's nest
features.look: A heap of sticks on the ledge below, wide as a cart, littered with the bones of hares and lambs.

actions.search: You lean out as far as you dare. Bones, a shining buckle, and an eagle's feather as long as your forearm. Out of reach.
actions.take: The eagle appears out of nowhere and makes its opinion of that very clear. You pull back.

title: The Cave Mouth
