description: A wide cave mouth in the cliff, the floor trampled and strewn with bones and fur. A smell comes out of the dark: rank, musky, animal. Claw marks score the rock at the entrance higher than you can reach. The ledge is east, and the cave goes on west into darkness.

features.name: the claw marks
features.look: Long parallel scores in the rock, higher than your head. Something stood up here and stretched.

actions.touch: Your fingers fit in the grooves with room to spare.
actions.search: Four long scores, well above your head. Bear. Big bear.

features.name: the bones and fur
features.look: Old bones and tufts of brown fur, trampled into the dirt.

actions.search: Bones, fur, and a broken boar spear with the head bitten off.

title: The Bear's Cave
description: A deep cave smelling overpoweringly of bear. The floor is a nest of dry bracken and bones. Water drips somewhere further in. The cave mouth is east, a grey shape of daylight.

features.name: the bracken nest
features.look: A great hollow scraped out and lined with bracken, warm and stinking.

actions.touch: Warm. Very recently warm.
actions.search: In the bracken, among the bones, a rusted knife and a silver button.

features.name: the drip
features.look: Somewhere back in the dark, water drips into a pool. Plink. Plink.

actions.listen: Plink. Plink. And breathing that is not yours.
actions.drink: You find the little pool by touch and drink. Cold and tasting of stone.

title: The Blackwood Edge
description: The wood changes all at once: the birches stop, and black trunked oaks and firs take over, close together, the light going green and then grey. The ground is soft with needles and very quiet. The Toll Stump is west, the wet ditch south, a high bank rises north, and a deer trail runs east.

features.name: the black trunks
features.look: Oaks black with damp and firs dark as ink, so close together their branches knit overhead.

actions.touch: Damp bark, cold as a cellar wall.
actions.listen: The forest swallows sound. Your own breathing is the loudest thing here.
actions.search: Dry sticks under the firs, and a snapped arrow fletched with crow feathers.

features.name: the needles
features.look: A deep brown carpet of needles and twigs.

actions.take: You pick out a good dry stick.
actions.search: Under the needles, sticks and a few mushrooms you would not eat.

title: The High Bank
description: A ridge of high ground above Brigand's Bend, thick with holly. From here you can look straight down on the road through the leaves without being seen. Someone has made themselves comfortable: a log to sit on, a ring of stones for a small fire, bones. The bend is west, down the bank. The wood goes on east, and the edge is south.

features.name: the watcher's log
features.look: A log dragged into the holly as a seat, worn smooth on top, with a clear view of the road below.

actions.sit: You sit on the brigands' log. It's a good view. You can see why they like it.
actions.search: Carved into the log: a list of initials and numbers. A tally of travellers.

features.name: the fire ring
features.look: A ring of stones around cold ashes. Small fires only, the kind you can't see from the road.

actions.touch: The ashes are cold. Mostly.
actions.search: Chicken bones, a rind of cheese, a cracked clay pipe.

title: The Deer Trail
description: A deer trail winds through the Blackwood, a narrow thread of beaten earth between the trunks. The trees here are huge. The edge is west, the old oaks north, and the trail goes on east toward a hunter's blind.

features.name: the trail
features.look: Beaten earth with slots in it. Deer, and boar, and once, one print as wide as a dinner plate.

actions.search: Deer slots, boar tracks, and one great pad print with claws. Old, you hope.
actions.touch: Packed hard and damp.

features.name: the huge trees
features.look: Oaks so old their trunks are hollow, big enough to stand inside.

actions.search: Inside a hollow oak, a dry space, dead leaves, and sticks.
actions.climb: Too wide to climb. You might as well climb a house.

title: The Old Oaks
description: A grove of oaks so old they have gone strange, twisted into knots and arches, hung with moss like grey hair. Mistletoe grows in the crowns. The ground is lumpy with roots. Paths go every way: west to the high bank, south to the trail, east to a wallow and north to the dens.

features.name: the twisted oaks
features.look: Trunks that split and rejoin, branches that grow down to the ground and root again. Faces in the bark, if you look too long.

actions.touch: The moss is cold and wet.
actions.listen: Creaks, all around, like old men shifting in their chairs.
actions.search: If you look long enough, every trunk has a face. You stop looking.

features.name: the mistletoe
features.look: Bunches of mistletoe high in the crowns, white berries like pearls.

actions.take: Too high to reach.
actions.search: White berries high up, like a crown of pearls on an old head.

title: The Hunter's Blind
description: A hunter's blind of woven branches stands at the edge of a small glade where the deer come to drink at a spring. Inside it there's room for two people and a bow. Nobody has used it lately. The trail is west, a wallow north, and the trees grow strange and dark to the east.

features.name: the blind
features.look: A low shelter of woven hazel and fern, with a slot to look through.

actions.sit: You crouch in the blind and watch the glade. A deer comes, sees nothing, and drinks.
actions.search: Inside the blind: a broken bowstring, a flask, empty, and a tally of deer scratched on a rod.

features.name: the spring
features.look: A spring bubbling up among stones into a little pool, the mud around it trampled by hooves.

actions.drink: You drink from the spring. Sweet and very cold.
actions.touch: Icy.

title: The Boar Wallow
description: A churned up hollow of black mud where wild boar come to wallow, stinking of pig. The trees around are scraped bare at hip height by tusks. The oaks are west, the blind south, a thicket of thorns north, and a fallen giant of a tree lies to the east.

features.name: the mud
features.look: Black mud, churned to soup, full of the prints of cloven hooves. Some of them very big.

actions.smell: Pig, mud and a thick musk that sticks in your throat.
actions.touch: Your hand sinks to the wrist. You pull it out with a suck.

features.name: the scraped trees
features.look: Bark rubbed and torn away at hip height, and tusk marks in the wood.

actions.touch: The wood is smooth with rubbing, slick with mud.
actions.search: Coarse black bristles caught in the bark.

title: The Wolf Dens
description: A rocky bank with dark holes dug under the roots of the trees above it. The ground is littered with bones and the place smells of dog. A thorn thicket blocks the way east, though there's a path through, and the old oaks are south.

features.name: the den holes
features.look: Dark holes under the roots, the earth around them smooth with use. Yellow eyes, sometimes.

actions.listen: Breathing, and a low growl, very low.
actions.search: Not without a light and a wish to die.
actions.smell: Dark holes. Something looks back from one of them, then doesn't.

features.name: the scattered bones
features.look: Deer bones, cracked and scattered, and the skull of a sheep.

actions.search: Bones, and a brass collar with a name on it: BRAN. Somebody's dog, once.
actions.touch: Gnawed smooth.

title: The Thorn Thicket
description: A tangle of blackthorn and briar so dense it makes its own dusk. A tunnel runs through it at the height of a crouching man, where animals push through. Shreds of cloth hang on the thorns, and not from animals. The dens are west and the wallow south.

features.name: the thorn tunnel
features.look: A tunnel through the thorns, rubbed smooth at the sides.

actions.search: Caught on the thorns, threads of red wool. Somebody comes this way often.
actions.touch: Your sleeve catches on three thorns at once.

features.name: the cloth shreds
features.look: Strips of red wool torn off on the thorns.

actions.take: You pull off a thread of red wool. Brigand red, the town would say.
actions.search: Red wool, the colour the brigands wear on their arms.

title: The Hanging Wood
description: A dark stand of yews where the light barely reaches. Things hang from the branches: old boots, a lantern, the skull of a horse, little wooden figures turning slowly on strings. Nobody knows who hangs them. The blind is west and a fallen tree lies north.

features.name: the hanging things
features.look: Wooden figures, boots, a horse skull, an iron lantern with no glass, all turning slowly on cords from the yew branches.

actions.touch: The figures are carved like people, each one different. One looks a lot like Father Osmund.
actions.take: You reach for a figure. The cord is tied with a knot you have never seen and do not want to undo.
actions.listen: They knock together softly in the breeze, like someone tapping on a door.

features.name: the yews
features.look: Old yews, dark and poisonous, their red bark peeling.

actions.touch: Red flaking bark, oddly warm.
actions.eat: The berries of yew are poison. Even you know that.

title: The Fallen Giant
description: An enormous oak has come down here, roots and all, leaving a crater and a wall of earth and roots taller than a house. Its trunk lies away east into the wood like a road. The hanging wood is south and the wallow west.

features.name: the fallen trunk
features.look: A trunk as wide as a doorway, lying east along the ground and crusted with fungus.

actions.search: Along the top of the trunk, worn bark and muddy boot prints heading east. People walk this trunk like a road, into the wood.
actions.climb: You climb onto the trunk. It runs away east like a raised road, and boot prints run with it.
actions.touch: Soft with rot on top, hard as iron underneath.

features.name: the root wall
features.look: A wall of earth and torn roots twice your height, with stones caught in it.

actions.search: In the root wall, a hollow someone has used as a cache. Empty now, but for a twist of red wool.
actions.touch: Earth crumbles around your fingers.

title: The Stockade Gate
description: A rough stockade of sharpened stakes rings a clearing deep in the Blackwood, and its gate stands open, guarded. Inside, smoke and tents and the noise of people who think nobody can find them. A red rag flies from a pole. The trunk path back is west.

features.name: the stockade
features.look: Stakes as thick as your arm, sharpened and lashed, with gaps a child could slip through.

actions.touch: Rough and newly cut. They haven't been here long.
actions.climb: You start to climb and a voice above says, quite pleasantly, that it would put an arrow in you.

features.name: the red rag
features.look: A red rag on a pole: the brigands' colours.

actions.take: Too high, and too many people watching.
actions.search: A red rag, snapping in the wind. The colour of the arm bands.

title: The Tents
description: A muddy clearing full of patched tents and lean tos around a big fire. Stolen goods lie in heaps: a cart wheel, a saddle, sacks of meal. A ladder climbs a tall pine to a lookout. A bigger tent, striped and grand, stands to the east. The gate is south.

features.name: the stolen goods
features.look: Everything that ever went down the road and didn't arrive: sacks of meal, a cart wheel, a saddle, a church candlestick.

actions.search: Meal, salt, a saddle, a candlestick with Father Osmund's mark on the base. Nothing you could carry off with all these eyes on you.
actions.take: A dozen hands go to a dozen knives. You leave it.

features.name: the camp fire
features.look: A big fire with a cauldron hung over it. Something is stewing that smells better than anything in Gallowmere.

actions.touch: Hot. Very hot.

title: The Lookout Tree
description: A platform of boards nailed high in a pine, swaying with the tree. From here you can see the road through gaps in the trees, the bend, the toll stump, and travellers coming long before they see you. A horn hangs on a nail. The ladder is down.

features.name: the horn
features.look: A cow horn on a cord, for warning the camp.

actions.use: You raise the horn to your lips and think better of it. Every brigand in the wood would come up that ladder.
actions.touch: Smooth and greasy from many hands.

features.name: the view of the road
features.look: Through the trees: Brigand's Bend, the toll stump, and a long stretch of road both ways.

actions.listen: The road is quiet. The camp below is not.
actions.search: The road is laid out below like a stage. You can see exactly how they do it.

title: The Captain's Tent
description: A tent of striped canvas, the kind a lord might take to a tourney, now stained and patched. Inside: a camp bed with a fur on it, a table covered in maps and a strongbox, and a chair carved like a throne that came from someone's hall. The tents are west.

features.name: the maps
features.look: Maps of the road and the forest, marked with crosses and dates. One shows the town walls with notes in the margin.

actions.read: The road, marked with crosses for every ambush. The town walls with the guard changes noted. And at the top, the palisade of Vesna, circled twice, with a question mark.
actions.search: Under the maps, a list of names with sums beside them. Hook's name is on it. So is Dace's.

features.name: the strongbox
features.look: An iron strongbox, chained to the bed frame and locked.

actions.open: Locked tight, and chained to the bed.

title: The Stone Steps
description: Worn stone steps climb east through cedars, swept clean by someone who comes every morning. Moss grows in the joints and little stone foxes sit on either side every few steps, some wearing faded red bibs. Ahead, red gates rise between the trees. Mile Oak is down the steps to the west.

features.name: the stone foxes
features.look: Small stone foxes in pairs, one with a key in its mouth, one with a jewel. Their red bibs are faded pink.

actions.touch: Cold stone, worn smooth on the head by many hands.
actions.search: Behind one fox, someone has left a rice cake and a coin. You leave them.
actions.listen: Pairs of stone foxes, guardians of the path. One holds a key in its mouth, the other a jewel. They are watching, politely.

features.name: the swept steps
features.look: Old steps, each hollowed in the middle by centuries of feet, swept so clean you could eat off them.

actions.sit: You sit on the steps a while. The forest is very quiet here, and so are you.
actions.touch: Smooth and cool, worn hollow.

title: The Red Gates
description: A long row of gates painted vermilion stands one after another so close together that they make a tunnel of red, the path running through. Each post is painted with black characters. The light through them is warm and strange. Walkers keep to the side of the path; the middle is left for the god. The steps are west and the shrine's water basin is east.

features.name: the red gates
features.look: Two posts and two crossbeams, painted vermilion, over and over in a row. The black characters on the posts are names, and dates.

actions.read: Names and dates, one on each gate: the people who gave them. Some go back to before Gallowmere had walls.
actions.touch: Smooth painted wood, warm as if in sun.
actions.search: A tunnel of red gates. The path down the middle is worn smoother than the edges, and yet everyone who comes here keeps to the edges.

features.name: the middle of the path
features.look: The very centre of the path, left clear. It is said that the centre belongs to the god who lives here.

actions.touch: Not a speck of dust on it.
actions.search: Nobody walks the middle. You can keep to the side of the path: keep to the side, then walk on east.

title: The Water Basin
description: Under a little roof on four posts sits a stone basin brimming with water from a bamboo pipe, with long handled wooden ladles laid across it. Here pilgrims purify their hands and mouths before going on to the shrine. The red gates are west and the shrine is east.

features.name: the water basin
features.look: A trough of grey stone, always full, always overflowing a little. Ladles of pale wood lie across it.

actions.use: You take up a ladle. To do it properly: purify.
actions.drink: You know better than to drink straight from the basin. You rinse with the ladle: purify.
actions.touch: The water is cold and very clear.

features.name: the bamboo pipe
features.look: A bamboo pipe leading the water down from a spring higher up, trickling steadily.

actions.listen: The trickle of water, and nothing else.
actions.touch: Green and cool.

title: The Shrine
description: A small wooden shrine under a sweeping roof of cedar bark, grey with age and perfectly kept. A wooden offering box sits before it, and above the box hangs a thick rope of red and white with a bronze bell at its top. Behind a lattice, the inner shrine is dark. Everything here is quiet. The water basin is west, and the fortune tree is north.

features.name: the offering box
features.look: A wooden box with a slatted top, worn dark by hands. Coins clink when they fall in.

actions.use: You stand before the offering box. Offer a coin: offer 1.
actions.touch: Smooth wood, worn by a thousand years of hands.
actions.search: An old wooden offering box with a slatted lid. Then you ring the bell, bow twice, clap twice, pray, and bow once more.

features.name: the bell rope
features.look: A thick braided rope of red and white, hanging from a bronze bell above the offering box.

actions.use: You take hold of the rope. Ring it: ring bell.
actions.touch: Rough cord, worn soft where people grip it.
actions.search: A bronze bell, green with age, and a thick rope to shake it.

features.name: the inner shrine
features.look: Behind the lattice: darkness, a mirror catching a little light, and the smell of cedar.

actions.touch: You do not reach through the lattice. Some things are not for touching.
actions.search: Darkness, a round mirror, the scent of cedar and old incense.

title: The Fortune Tree
description: Behind the shrine stands an old plum tree, and its every lower twig is tied with folded paper slips, white against the dark bark, like blossom in the wrong season. A small stall beside it holds a wooden box of fortunes. The shrine is south.

features.name: the knotted slips
features.look: Hundreds of paper fortunes knotted to the twigs, bad luck left behind by people who drew it.

actions.touch: Paper, soft with rain. Every one of them a bad fortune, tied here and left.
actions.read: You don't untie them. They're bad luck, left here for the tree to keep.

features.name: the fortune box
features.look: A hexagonal wooden box with a hole in one end. You shake it and a numbered stick falls out, and that number is your fortune.

actions.use: Draw a fortune for a coin: draw fortune.
actions.search: A wooden box of numbered sticks, and drawers of paper slips. One coin a draw.

title: The Fox's Grove
description: A hidden glade behind the shrine, ringed by cedars so old they have grown together into a wall. Moss covers everything, deep and soft. In the middle sits a tiny shrine no bigger than a doll's house, and in front of it a stone bowl. Pale lights drift between the trees, there and not there. The way back south is narrow and hard to see.

features.name: the tiny shrine
features.look: A shrine the size of a doll's house, perfect in every detail, with a little stone fox at its door.

actions.touch: Warm. Warmer than stone has any right to be.
actions.search: A tiny shrine, cared for by no hand you can see. The fox at its door has nine tails, carved fine as hair.

features.name: the stone bowl
features.look: A shallow stone bowl, and in it, something that glows a soft blue green, like moonlight on water.

actions.touch: The light is cool, like a stream.
actions.search: In the bowl lies a little ball of pale light, cool and steady.

title: The Gatherers' Hall
description: A long cold hall of grey stone, scrubbed and smelling of lime. Slabs line the walls, some of them occupied under clean sacking. A tall desk stands at the far end with a great ledger open on it, and beside it a board of wanted names. Everything is very orderly, and very quiet. Butcher's Alley is west.

features.name: the slabs
features.look: Stone slabs, each with a shape under clean sacking and a tag on its toe.

actions.read: Toe tags: names, where found, by whom, and how much was paid. The handwriting is very neat.
actions.touch: Cold stone. Colder sacking.
actions.search: You lift a sacking corner. A cutpurse, looking surprised still. You put it back.

features.name: the wanted board
features.look: A board of slates on which bodies wanted by somebody are chalked, with a price.

actions.read: The wanted board. Type board to read it properly.
actions.search: Slates, chalked with wants and prices. Type board.

features.name: the great ledger
features.look: A ledger as big as a gravestone, every body that ever came through the hall written in it in a careful hand.

actions.read: Name, place, finder, payment. Pages and pages. Some names appear as finders on one page and as bodies on another.
actions.touch: Warden Crane's eyes are on you before your fingers reach it.

title: The Sleeping Lantern
description: A low common room behind the Drowned Rat, warm and quiet and smelling of beeswax and old blankets. A lantern burns in the window day and night. Benches, a hearth, a counter with a key board behind it, and stairs going up to the loft and the rooms. The Rat's yard is north.

features.name: the lantern
features.look: A brass lantern in the window, always lit. Old Peg says if it ever goes out, so does she.

actions.touch: Warm brass.
actions.search: It has never gone out, Old Peg says. You believe her.

features.name: the key board
features.look: A board of hooks behind the counter, two keys on it, and a slate of prices.

actions.read: LOFT, A BED, 2. ROOM WITH A CHEST, 6. TILL MORNING. NO FIGHTING. NO BODIES. NO EXCEPTIONS.
actions.take: Old Peg's hand lands on yours like a lid on a pot. Rent first: rent bed, or rent room.

features.name: the hearth
features.look: A small banked fire, kept just warm enough.

actions.sit: You sit by the hearth. Your eyes start to close on their own.
actions.touch: Warm stones.

title: The Lantern Loft
description: A long attic under the thatch with a row of straw beds along each side, blankets folded at the foot of each. Somebody snores. A narrow landing runs off to a door on either side, the private rooms, east and west. The stairs go down.

features.name: the straw beds
features.look: Straw mattresses on the boards, each with a grey blanket. Rented by the night. sleep, once you've paid.

actions.sit: You sit on a bed. It crackles. Rent one and you can sleep: rent bed, then sleep.
actions.touch: Straw, and a blanket that has been washed, recently, which is more than you expected.

features.name: the private doors
features.look: Two narrow doors with iron latches, one east and one west. Private rooms, each with a chest.

actions.knock: You knock. Nobody answers. Rent one from Old Peg: rent room.

title: The East Room
description: A tiny room under the eaves with a proper bed, a washstand, a stool and an iron bound chest at the foot of the bed. A small window looks out over the rooftops to the temple bell tower. The door is west.

features.name: the chest
features.look: An iron bound oak chest with a stout lock. Your things are safe in here while the room is yours: store, retrieve.

actions.open: Use store <item> and retrieve <item>, while the room is yours.
actions.touch: Solid oak and cold iron.

features.name: the bed
features.look: A real bed with a feather pillow. Luxury, by Gallowmere standards.

actions.sit: You sit on the bed and sink. Sleep here: sleep.
actions.touch: Feathers. Actual feathers.

title: The West Room
description: A small room with a sloping ceiling, a bed with a patchwork quilt, a candle on a shelf and an iron bound chest. The window looks down into the Rat's yard. The door is east.

features.name: the chest
features.look: An iron bound oak chest with a stout lock. Your things are safe in here while the room is yours: store, retrieve.

actions.open: Use store <item> and retrieve <item>, while the room is yours.
actions.touch: Solid oak and cold iron.

features.name: the quilt
features.look: A patchwork quilt made of a hundred scraps, each one a different shade of brown.

actions.sit: You sit on the bed. The quilt is heavy and warm. Sleep here: sleep.
actions.touch: Warm and heavy.
